title: Cat's Combat Log
description: An alternative to normal combat logging, as this does not instantly kill the person. It instead spawns a fake copy of the player.
body:
Combat logging alternative which does not instantly kill you,

Instead it spawns a fake player (mannequin) of the person who combat logged.

If however the server is on an older version (minimum 1.21.9) it will instantly kill you as Mannequins dont exist in 1.21.8 and below.

Commands: 

/combatlog reload: reloads the plugin

/combatlog status: says the current status of the combat log configuration

/combatlog config <key> <value>: lets you configure the plugin in game

/combatlog help: shows help

/combatlog tag <player1> <player2>: Tags 2 people into combat

ANY ISSUES/BUGS CAN BE REPORTED IN MY DISCORD SERVER!!
